On a grey Tuesday morning he found a green bottle wedged between the rocks below the tower. Inside was a single page, damp at the edges. 'To whoever keeps the light: my brother sailed past your coast in 1987 and never came home. I only want to know that someone was watching.' Tomas read it three times. That night he climbed the stairs earlier than usual, polished the lens until it shone, and lit the lamp. Then he sat down at his small table and began a letter that started, 'I was watching.'", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还在沉睡。路灯投下昏黄的光，空旷的街道像一条安静的河。远处传来清洁工扫帚划过地面的沙沙声，早点铺的蒸笼刚刚冒出第一缕白气。高楼的窗户大多漆黑，只有几盏灯固执地亮着，像是未眠人留下的心事。出租车偶尔驶过，轮胎碾过积水，溅起细碎的声响。风带着露水的凉意吹来，天边仍是深蓝，却已隐约透出一线微白。这座喧闹的城市，此刻终于安静地属于自己。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of Russian nesting dolls: you open one doll and find a smaller doll, and you keep opening until you reach the tiniest one.\n- The tiniest doll is the stopping point, and once you reach it you can put everything back together."}
